Legal

Privacy

What we store when you ask for a free tool, why, and how to get off the list. Last updated 2026-10-10.

Who we are

The Leverage Point Co is a brand of Systemyx Ventures, South Africa. We are the responsible party for your personal information under the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Contact: theleveragepointco@gmail.com.

What we store

  • When you ask for a tool: your email address, your first name if you give it, the tool and video you came from, any campaign tags in the link, the date and time, and the exact consent wording you agreed to.
  • Abuse protection: a one-way scrambled (salted hash) form of your IP address, used only to limit repeated sign-ups. We never store the IP address itself.
  • Email delivery: which emails we sent you and whether delivery worked.
  • Clicks: which tool and kit links are clicked, without your name or email.
  • Purchases: if you buy a kit, Lemon Squeezy processes the payment and shares your email and order with us so we can support you.

Why

  • To send you the tool you asked for.
  • With your consent, to email you occasionally about new tools and kits.
  • To see which tools are useful, and to stop abuse.

Who processes it

Cloudflare (stores the list and runs the sign-up service), Brevo and Resend (send the emails), Lemon Squeezy (payments). They process data only to provide these services. Some of them store data outside South Africa; we use them because they provide adequate protection under their own data-protection terms. We never sell your data or use it for advertising.

Unsubscribe and your rights

Every email has an unsubscribe link; one click removes you from the list straight away. You can also email theleveragepointco@gmail.com to see, correct or delete what we hold about you, or to object to processing. You may complain to the Information Regulator (South Africa) at inforegulator.org.za.

How long we keep it

While you are on the list. After you unsubscribe we keep only your email address and the unsubscribe date, so we never email you by mistake again. Ask us and we delete that too.
